label: PF Backlog 78
title: BUG: tech-stack detection matches 'go' in prose -> injects Go stack + Go style guide into prompts
body: Observed: the project idea contains '...go through the feature...'; core tech detection interpreted 'go' as the Go language, so the prompt builder injected 'SCOPE & TECH STACK (MUST follow): go.' and routed the Go style guide to agents (the discovery model's reasoning referenced it). docs/tech-stack.json was absent so nothing corrected it. Fix: detect_tech_from_text must use word-boundary + language-context signals (not bare 'go'); ignore common English usage; require corroboration; and never inject a stack unless chosen/confirmed. Refs: core/tech_stack.py, core/orchestrator/prompt_builder.py, config/project-config.json.
